content.text:
The result of (37 × 12 + 159) ÷ 9 is **67**.

The Calculator has no parentheses in this mode, so I ran it in two parts: 37 × 12 + 159 = 603, then 603 ÷ 9 = 67. A single unbroken entry gave 461.67 because the Calculator applies normal precedence.
